changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionStatusLog') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionStatusLog]( [ID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [FusionID] [int] NOT NULL, [DateStarted] [datetime] NOT NULL, [DateCompleted] [datetime] NULL, [MachineQueuedOn] [varchar](250) NULL, [Success] [bit] NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [FullRefresh] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionStatusLog_FullRefresh] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionStatusLog] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionStatusLog_Fusion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionStatusLog] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionStatusLog_Fusion] FOREIGN KEY([FusionID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Fusion] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionStatusLog] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionStatusLog_Fusion] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_FusionStatusLog') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_FusionStatusLog] ON [dbo].[FusionStatusLog] ( [FusionID] ASC, [DateCompleted] DESC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FusionStatusLog_DateStarted_FusionID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FusionStatusLog_DateStarted_FusionID] ON [dbo].[FusionStatusLog] ( [FusionID] ASC, [DateStarted] DESC ) END
